What are the symptoms of covid

Common symptoms of COVID-19 include:
- Loss of taste or smell
- Extreme tiredness (fatigue)
- Digestive symptoms such as upset stomach, vomiting, or diarrhea
- Pain such as headaches and body or muscle aches
- Fever or chills
- Cold-like symptoms such as congestion, runny nose, or sore throat

People may have only a few symptoms or none at all. Some symptoms may worsen about 7 to 14 days after they start.

The COVID-19 vaccines available include:

- Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine 2024-2025 formula, for people age 6 months and older.
- Moderna COVID-19 vaccine 2024-2025 formula, for people age 6 months and older.
- Novavax COVID-19 vaccine, adjuvanted 2024-2025 formula, for people age 12 years and older.

People age 5 and older with typical immune systems can receive any approved vaccine for their age. Some groups, such as children ages 6 months to 4 years and people with weakened immune systems, should get all doses from the same vaccine maker.
